messages:
Maria Chen: Quick update — legal signoff came through for the v1->v2 deprecation banner copy. We need a short, localized banner on docs pages + updated SDK snippets that show v2 usage and a small compatibility note. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2437

Samir Patel: timeline? do we do a global flip or stagger by region? also can we add a tiny analytics ping on banner click so PM can measure impact? :bar_chart:

Maria Chen: Target rollout: banner live Mon Apr 6 (hosted docs only), doc redirects and snippet updates follow on Apr 13. Stagger APAC by one week (per legal/regional review). Analytics: yes, please add `docs.banner.deprec_click` event.

Lee Wong: I can own Node + Python snippet rewrites. Will keep the v1 shim example under a collapsible note. Opening PR for snippets today.

Maria Chen: Thanks Lee — decision on content: show short v2 example first, then a 1-line collapsible note: "If you're still on v1, add header X-Compat: true". Avoid big code blocks for shim.

Lee Wong: Ack. Example for Node (draft):
```
// v2 minimal
await fetch('https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'rwft/gpt-2-large', prompt: 'Hello' })
})
```
I'll include a 1-liner showing the compat header for v1 fallback.

Priya Rao: I18n note — l10n team needs the final banner strings by EOD Friday to hit Apr 6. Also confirm which langs: en, fr, de, ja, es. l10n-bot: can you queue the strings once PR is merged?

l10n-bot: queued — will create job when /strings-ready is posted. Please tag locales in PR description.

Samir Patel: Heads-up: audits team flagged that some pages have deep links used by customers; we should not remove v1 docs pages until redirects are in place. Add a redirect checklist item to PR.

Maria Chen: Good catch — adding checklist to PR: redirect entries, smoke test script, GA event, l10n strings, snippet owners, legal approval note.

Docs CI Bot: docs build passed for branch update/snippet-rewrite (job #987).

Lee Wong: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2445 — Node/Python snippets, includes collapsible v1 note. Need someone to sanity-check Go and Ruby snippets.

Priya Rao: I can review Go. Samir — can you take Ruby? Also will start localization file prep once PR is green.

Samir Patel: I'll take Ruby. Quick question: do we include an example showing model swap behavior (when hosted routes fallback to smaller model)? Might be out of scope for the banner but useful in migration guide.

Maria Chen: Not on the banner, but add a short paragraph in the migration guide page linking to model-fallback docs and the Optimize recommendations. Please open a follow-up PR referencing this thread.

Lee Wong: Sounds good. I'll add a line: "For model fallback details see /guides/model-fallback" and a note about token/latency differences.

Maria Chen: Final action items pinned to PR: 
- Lee: finish Node/Python PR (#2445) and include collapsible v1 shim note.
- Samir: Ruby snippet update + redirect checklist.
- Priya: Go review + l10n prep.
- Maria: merge banner copy once l10n strings are queued and CI green.

Samir Patel: ETA: Ruby PR by EOD.

Priya Rao: I18n prep done once job is queued; targeting translations in <72h post-queue.

Docs CI Bot: reminder — run smoke tests after redirects are added: `scripts/docs-smoke.sh`.

Maria Chen: Thanks team — I'll post a short announcement in #announcements once banner is scheduled. :thumbsup:
